title: Joyful Mysteries
subtitle: Prayed on Mondays & Saturdays
introText: The Joyful Mysteries focus on the incarnation and early hidden life of Jesus Christ.

mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.description: Gabriel brings the good news, Mary accepts God’s will and the Holy Spirit overshadows her. The Holy Spirit brings Christ to us. (Luke 1:26-38)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer
mysteries.prayer: God our Father we pray for those who carried the Good News of Jesus Christ to their brothers and sisters: missionaries, priests, deacons, catechists, parents and leaders of children’s liturgy. May they be full of gifts of the Holy Spirit.

mysteries.title: The Visitation
mysteries.description: Mary visits her cousin Elizabeth whose child, filled with the Holy Spirit recognises the Good News of Jesus Christ. (Luke 1:39-45)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer
mysteries.prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, we pray for all those who have recognised you as the Good News of salvation We ask you to show us the way to share the Gospel with those who do not know you. May we join with Mary in proclaiming “My soul glorifies the Lord my spirit rejoices in God my saviour.”

mysteries.title: The Nativity of the Son of God
mysteries.description: The birth of Jesus is proclaimed to the shepherd and they believe. (Luke 2:1-7)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer
mysteries.prayer: Holy Spirit, we ask you to be with us when we find it difficult to believe, when our faith is weak, when doubts trouble our minds. At these times let us joyfully sing with the angelic hosts: “Glory to God on high and earth peace to those who enjoy God’s favour.”

mysteries.title: The Presentation in the Temple
mysteries.description: The parents of Jesus fulfil the law. Simeon and Anna, filled with the Spirit, recognise a special child and prophecy his future and that of Mary. (Luke 2: 22-35)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer
mysteries.prayer: Let us pray for our own intentions.

mysteries.title: The Finding of the Child Jesus in the Temple
mysteries.description: Jesus reminds his parents that he must do his Father’s work but returns with them and remains obedient to their authority for many years. (Luke 2:41-52)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer
mysteries.prayer: O Holy Trinity we pray for all. May those you call, hear and follow your voice to your Father’s work.

title: Sorrowful Mysteries
subtitle: Prayed on Tuesdays & Fridays
introText: The Sorrowful Mysteries reflect upon the Passion and Death of Jesus Christ.

mysteries.title: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.description: Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to his disciples, “Sit here while I go over to pray”.  He went a little farther and fell to the ground, with his face touching the earth, and prayed, “Father if it is possible, take the cup away from me. Yet not my will but yours be done. (Matthew 26:36,39)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.description: They shouted, “Crucify him!” Pilate asked them, “What harm has he done?”. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”. So, Pilate, anxious to placate the crowd, release Barabbas for them and after having Jesus scourged, he handed him over to be crucified. (Mark 15:13-15)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.description: They stripped him and dressed him in a scarlet cloak. Then, twisting a crown of thorns, they forced it into onto his head, and placed a reed in his right hand. They knelt before Jesus and mocked him saying, “Hail, king of the Jews!” (Matthew 27:28-29)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.description: Bearing his own cross, Jesus went out to the Place of the Skull or as it is called Hebrew, Golgotha, where they crucified him with two others, one on either side, and Jesus in the middle. (John 19:17-18)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Crucifixion and Death of Jesus Christ
mysteries.description: It was now about the sixth hour and the sun’s light failed, so that darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour. The veil of the Sanctuary was torn right down the middle. Jesus cried out with a loud voice saying, “Father, into your hands I commend my spirit.” With these words he breathed his last. (Luke 23:44-46)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

title: Glorious Mysteries
subtitle: Prayed on Wednesdays & Sundays
introText: The Glorious Mysteries celebrate the triumph of Christ over sin and death.

mysteries.title: The Resurrection
mysteries.description: The Angel said to the woman “You need not be amazed! You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, the one who was crucified. He has been raised up; He is not here. See the place where they laid him. (Matthew 28:5-6)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Ascension
mysteries.description: Then after speaking to them, the Lord Jesus was taken up into heaven and took His seat at God’s right hand. (Acts 1:6-11)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.description: And there appeared to them tongues of fire and they rested on each of them. And they filled with the Holy Spirit began to speak with other tongues, as the spirit was giving them utterance. (Acts 2:2-4)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Assumption of Our Lady
mysteries.description: For behold from this time on all generations will call me blessed. “For the Mighty One has done great things for me; and Holy is His name. (Luke 1:48–49)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: Crowning of Our Blessed Lady
mysteries.description: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars. (Revelation 12:1)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

title: Luminous Mysteries
subtitle: Prayed on Thursdays
introText: The Luminous Mysteries highlight key events during the public ministry of Jesus Christ.

mysteries.title: The Baptism of Jesus by John the Baptist
mysteries.description: It was at this time that Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptised in the Jordan by John. And at once as he was coming up of the water, he saw the heavens torn apart and the Spirit, like a dove descending on him. And a voice came from heaven, “You are my Son, the beloved; my favour rests on you.” (Mark 1:9-11)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.description: Jesus turns water into wine at the request of his mother. This was the first of Jesus’ signs: it was a Cana in Galilee. He was revealed by his glory, and his disciples believed in him. After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and his brothers and his disciples, but they stayed there only for a few days. (John 2:11-12)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom of God
mysteries.description: Jesus goes through the towns and cities of Galilee and Judea proclaiming God’s kingdom: “The time is fulfilled and the kingdom of God is close at hand. Repent and believe the good news.” (Mark 1:14-15)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Transfiguration
mysteries.description: He took with him Peter, James and John and went up the mountain to pray. And it happened that, as he was praying, the aspect of his face changed and his clothing became sparkling white. And suddenly there were two men talking to him, Moses and Elijah appearing in glory and they were speaking of his passing. (Luke 9:28-31)
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer

mysteries.title: The Institution of the Holy Eucharist at the Last Supper
mysteries.description: This is my body; this is my blood offered for you.
mysteries.decprayer: Our Father, 10 x Hail Mary, Glory Be, Fatima Prayer
